stage1.summary: KPI growth remains robust and aligned with thesis, but extreme valuation premium and lack of NDR disclosure introduce material uncertainty.
positives: Commercial revenue more than doubled YoY with contribution margin reaching 73%
Government segment continues steady expansion without visible share loss
concerns: Current price implies 53% upside to theoretical value, signaling aggressive growth assumptions
No updated NDR or churn data provided despite being central to exit condition #1
stage1.recommendation_reason: Strong top-line momentum supports continuation but valuation gap and missing retention metrics require closer monitoring before increasing exposure.
next_kpis: Government contract renewal/win rate on major programs
stage1.exit_distance_reason: None of the four exit triggers are close; growth and margins remain elevated and no governance or regulatory signals have emerged.
stage1.optimism_bias_warning: Theoretical price 35% below market indicates the market is pricing in near-perfect execution; any deceleration will likely trigger sharp multiple compression.

bear.rationale: Commercial growth decelerates sharply as large deals normalize; government budget constraints tighten; contribution margin plateaus below 70% due to mix shift and higher CAC.

base.rationale: Commercial growth moderates to mid-teens after 2026; government sustains low-teens; contribution margin stabilizes near 68-70% with gradual operating leverage.

bull.rationale: Commercial continues 25%+ growth on new vertical wins; government accelerates with platform standardization; contribution margin reaches 72%+ with scale.

key_assumptions: NDR remains unreported and is assumed at 110-115% (10% haircut to any management claim)
Commercial contribution margin normalizes to 65-68% after 2026 due to customer mix
Total revenue base uses 2026Q1 annualized run-rate with 40/60 commercial/government split
risk_factors: Absence of updated NDR/churn data increases downside uncertainty
Current valuation already prices aggressive growth; any miss triggers multiple compression
Government revenue concentration exposes to budget delays and policy shifts
